entities.summary: Wietske Annechien de Ruiter is a former female field hockey striker from the Netherlands, who represented her native country at two consecutive Summer Olympics: 1992 and 1996. At the last tournament in Atlanta, Georgia the former player of Hockey Vereniging Victoria in Rotterdam and HGC won the bronze medal with the Dutch women's team.
